description: This Java class 'MessagesCentral' manages messages from firmware and UI panels, enabling registration of listeners and dispatching messages to them, with thread-safe handling and logging.

classes.name: MessagesCentral
classes.description: Singleton class that manages firmware and UI messages, allowing listeners to subscribe and receive message notifications, with thread safety and logging.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of MessagesCentral.

methods.name: addListener
methods.description: Registers a MessageListener to receive messages.

methods.name: postMessage
methods.description: Posts a message to all registered listeners, logging the message and dispatching it on the AWT thread.
